rationale.usefulness: Documented small English selectors, CLI/Python/server routes and public no-cloning inventories support focused narration pilots for teaching pages, app feedback and draft video tracks. The report gives practical listening and integration checks and correctly treats browser ports and alignment as separate work.
rationale.impact: The documented reduction from approximately 100M parameters to 18.2M and 6.9M, with encouraging publisher metrics, is meaningful for local speech deployment. The smallest model loses quality, the speed hardware is unspecified, and no measured application benefit supports a stronger field-wide rating.
rationale.novelty: Component-wise backbone, head and decoder reduction is a substantive extension of an existing speech family. The contribution is an efficiency and quality tradeoff with inspectable methods, not a new speech-generation paradigm, language expansion or independently demonstrated expressive capability.
rationale.maturity: The existing package interfaces, model configurations, visible artifacts and v4.0.1 maintenance release support usable experimentation. A recent pronunciation fix, untested updated weights, limited English evaluation and no listening or service-capacity tests keep reliability bounded.
rationale.openness: MIT code, CC BY 4.0 model labels, public no-cloning artifacts and detailed methods give meaningful portability and inspectability. The main model gate, separate prohibited-use notice, mixed voice-asset terms and incomplete independently reproduced training or execution prevent an unrestricted-openness score.

concerns: The October 21 v4.0.1 release claim was checked against its archived notes. The report correctly keeps the October 20 benchmark figures separate and does not imply that those figures were rerun on patched weights.
CPU throughput is not first-audio latency, and listed file size is not resident memory. The original article does not identify the CPU for its one-thread speed table.
Code, weights and exact voice assets carry separate conditions; community browser implementations do not establish official small-variant browser support.
No gate was accepted, weights downloaded, audio generated or listening comparison performed during this review.
